signatures.description: Implement an RFC 9438 CUBIC congestion controller plus DCTCP-style ECN CE counter/epoch accounting for a simulated QUIC sender driven by a scripted ack trace (acked ranges, loss marks, CE marks with ack-eliciting timestamps). alpha must be derived from the CE fraction of each completed epoch and applied once per RTT, CUBIC growth must anchor on the post-reduction window with correct fast-convergence handling, and spurious loss detection must undo the reduction exactly without double-counting the recovered bytes. Expose simulate(trace) -> {cwnd[], alpha[], epochs[]} and make the output bit-identical across runs and independent of Map/Set insertion order.
